m: वैताढ्य m. N. of a mountain, Śatr.
वैताली f. (with सुन्दरी) a kind of metre, Ghaṭ., Sch.

v: pu॰ mAtrAvfttaBede । “zaqvizame'zwO same kalAstASca same syurno nirantarAH । na samA'tra parASritA kalA vEtAlIye'nte ralO guruH” vf॰ ra॰ ।
m: वैतालीय mfn. relating to the Vetālas, VarBṛS.
वैतालीय n. a kind of metre, VarBṛS.
वैताल mf(ई)n. (fr. वेताल) relating to the Vetālas, VarBṛS.
वैताल m. = वेताल, Siṃhās.
वैतालकि m. N. of a teacher of the Ṛg-veda, VP.
वैताल—पुर n. N. of a town, Siṃhās. (v.l. वेताल-प्˚).

s: puM, (viviGena tAlena caratIti । vitAla + Wak .) boDakaraH । ityamaraH ॥ dve niSAnte boDakArake । viviDo maNgalagItivAdyAdikftastAlaSabdaH tena vyavaharanti vEtAlikAH QaGe kAditi zRikaH । niSAntaM nivedayanto ye nfpaM boDayanti jAgarayanti te boDakarAH sfkuzwa iti waH । iti BarataH ॥ (yaTA, SiSupAlavaDe । 5 । 67 । “vEtAlikAH sPuwapadaprakawArTamuccErBogAvalIH kalagiro'vasarezu peWuH ॥”) KewwitAlaH । yaTA, -- “vEtAlikaH pumAn KewwitAle boDakare trizu ॥” iti medinI ॥ hemacandre tu pAWAntaraM yaTA, -- “vEtAlikaH KaqjatAle maNgalapAWake'pi ca ॥” vetAlasambanDini, tri ॥
v: tri॰ viviDastAlaH maNgalagItAdiSabdastena vyava harati Wak । maNgalastutyAdiBiH rAjYAM pravoDakArake mAgaDAdO amaraH ।
m: 1. वैतालिक m. one who is possessed by a Vetāla, the servant of a Vetāla, W.
the worshipper of a Vetāla, MW.
a magician, conjurer, ib.
2. वैतालिक m. (fr. वि-ताल) a bard, panegyrist of a king (whose duty also is to proclaim the hour of day), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
= -खेड्डताल, L.
one who sings out of tune (?), W. (prob. w.r. for 2. वैतानिक above)
वैतालिक n. knowledge of one of the 64 arts, BhP., Sch.
a: वैतालिकः — [विविधस्तालस्तेन व्यवहरति ठक्] 1 A bard, minstrel. --2 A magician, conjurer; especially, one who is a votary of Vetāla q. v. --3 The servant of a Vetāla.

k.v: वैतालिका बोधकराश्चाक्रिका घाण्टिकार्थकाः। स्युर्मागधास्तु मगधा बन्दिनः स्तुतिपाठकाः॥

m: वैतालि-कर्णि m. (and ˚णिकण्थ n.) v.l. for बैडालि-क्˚, q.v.
वैतालि-कर्णि-कन्थ n.
वैतालिक—व्रत n. the duty of a bard, Bālar.
वैतालिन् m. N. of one of Skanda's attendants, MBh.
वैतान mf(ई)n. (fr. 2. वि-तान) relating to or performed with the three sacred fires, GṛŚrS.; Mn.; MBh.
वैतान m. (mc.) = वितान, a canopy, BhP. (accord. to Comm. = वितान-समूह)
a patr. Caraṇ. (v.l. वैतायन)
वैतान n. a rite performed with the three sacred fires, PārGṛ.; Mn. &c.
an oblation with fire, W.
a: वैतान — a. (नी f.) [वितान-अण्] Sacrificial, sacred; वैतानास्त्वां वह्नयः पावयंतु Ś. 4. 7. --नं 1 A sacrificial rite. --2 A sacrificial oblation.

m: वैतान—कुशल mfn. skilled in or conversant with the above rites, Mn.
वैतान—प्रायश्चित्त-सूत्र n. N. of wk.
वैतान—स्थ mfn. occupied in a sacrificial rite, MBh.
वैतान—सूत्र n. N. of wk.

s: puM, (vitAne BavaH । vitAna + Wak .) SrOtahomaH । yaTA, -- “maraRAdeva karttavyaM saMyogo yasya nAgninA । dAhAdUrdDvamaSOcaM syAdyasya vEtAniko viDiH ॥” iti SudDitattvam ॥ vitAnasambanDIye, tri । vitAnaSabdAt zRikapratyayena nizpannametat ॥ (yajYAdikAryyakArI । yaTA ca BAgavate । 10 । 40 । 5 । “trayyA ca vidyayA kecit tvAM vE vEtAnakA dvijAH । yajante vitatEryajYErnAnArUpAmarAKyayA ॥”)
v: pu॰ vitAnasyAyam Wak । 1 SrOtaviDinA'gnisTApane 2 vitAnasambanDini ca “dAhAdUrdDvamaSOcaM syAt yasya vEtAniko viDiH” smftiH । vitAnaSabde 4899 dfSyam ।
m: 1. वैतानिक mf(ई)n. = वैतान (with द्वि-ज or विप्र, a Brāhman who observes the precepts relative to the three sacred fires), GṛŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
sacrificial, sacred (as fire), W.
वैतानिक n. a burnt-offering (esp. of clarified butter, as presented daily by the Brāhmans), W.
2. वैतानिक mfn. (fr. 1. वि-तान) See under 2. वैतालिक below.
a: वैतानिक — a. (की f.) See वैतान --कं A burnt offering.

m: वैतानोपासना f. the regular presentation of burnt-offerings morning and evening, W.
वैतान्य n. despondency, Jātakam.
वैतायन m. a patr. Caraṇ. (v.l. वैतान).
वैतधृत m. pl. = वैनधृत, वैनभृत, AV.Pariś.

a: वैतंडिकः — A disputatious man, captious person.

m: वैतंसिकाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to act the part of a bird-catcher, ensnaring, inveigling, Jātakam.

s: tri, (vItaMso mfgapakzyAdibanDanopAyastena caratIti । vitaMsa + “carati .” 4 । 4 । 8 । iti Wak .) mAMsavikretA । tatparyyAyaH । kOwikaH 2 mAMsikaH 3 । ityamaraH ॥ kOwakikaH 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ mfgapakzyAdibanDanopAyo vItaMsaH tena caratIti vEtaMsikaH । iti BarataH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 33 । 33 । “imAn SakunakAnrAjan hanti vEtaMsiko yaTA । etadrUpamaDarmmasya BUtezu hi vihiMsatA ॥”)
v: tri॰ vitaMsena mfgaMpakzyAdibanDanopAyena carati Wak mAMsavikrayopajIvake vyADe amaraH ।
m: वैतंसिक m. (fr. वि-तंस, or वी-त्˚) a bird-catcher, MBh.
a butcher, L.
वैतंसिक n. the act of ensnaring or entrapping, catching insidiously, MBh. (cf. द्यूत-वैत्˚, धर्म-वैत्˚).

k.v: जीवान्तकः शाकुनिको द्वौ वागुरिकजालिकौ। वैतंसिकः कौटिकश्च मांसिकश्च समं त्रयम्.।

m: वैतण्डिक mfn. (fr. वि-तण्डा) skilled in the tricks or artifices of disputation g. कथादि
वैतण्डिक m. a disputations or captious person, MW.
वैतण्डिन् m. N. of a Ṛṣi, Hariv.
वैतण्ड्य m. N. of a son of the Vasu Āpa, VP.
वैतथ्य n. (fr. वि-तथ) falseness, MāṇḍUp., Sch.; BhP.
वैतथ्य—प्रकरण n. N. of ch. of a wk.
वैतथ्योपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad.
वैतहव्य m. (fr. वीत-हव्य) a patr. AV.; ĀrṣBr.; GṛŚrS.
वैतहव्य n. N. of various Sāmans, Br. &c.
वैतहोत्र m. a patr. MaitrS. iv, 2, 6 (perhaps w.r. for वैतिह्˚).

s: tri, (vetanena jIvatIti । vetana + “vetanAdiByo jIvati .” 4 । 4 । 12 । iti Wak .) vetanaBugBftyaH । tatparyyAyaH BftakaH 2 BftiBuk 3 karmmakaraH 4 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, upadeSaSatake । 20 । “vIro vEtanikaH sanvirAwanagarozitaH kumArIRAm । narttayitArjjuna AsIt BajedavasTocitAM vfttim ॥”)
v: tri॰ vetanena jIvati Wak । vetanopajIvake karmakare BftyAdo amaraH ।
m: वैतनिक mf(ई)n. (fr. वेतन) living on wages, serving for wages
वैतनिक m. a hireling, labourer, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12.
a: वैतनिक — a. (की f.) [वेतनेन जीवति ठक्] Living on wages. --कः 1 A hired labourer, labourer. --2 A stipendiary.

k.v: भृतको भृतिभुक्कर्मकरो वैतनिकोऽपि सः। वार्तावहो वैवधिको भारवाहस्तु भारिकः॥

s: strI, narakasinDuH । ityamaraH ॥ “vitaraRena dAnena tIryyate vEtaraRI । zRaH zittvAdIp zRO vEtaraRiSca । awavipawiGAwIvEteraRyarcciSuRWIriti hnasvAntezu rudraH । tato'pi pAcCoRAdIti vA Ip । virudDaM taraRaM vitaraRaM tadasyAmastIti vEtaraRItyanye । vitaraRO visUryye pAtAle BavA vEtaraRItyanye । vitaraRirvinOkA taraRaSUnyetyarTaH svArTe zRe vEtaraRItyeke । sinDurnadI । ‘nArakA jantavaH pretA nadI vEtaraRI smftA ॥’ iti trikARqam ॥” iti BarataH ॥ * ॥ sA nadI durganDA taptajalA mahAvegA asTikeSaraktaparipUrRA yamadbAre varttate । yaTA, -- “nadI vEtaraRI nAma durganDA ruDirAvahA । uzRatoyA mahAvegA asTikeSataraNgiRI ॥” iti prAyaScittavivekaDftayamadagnivacanam ॥ * ॥ asya utpattiryaTA, -- mArkaRqeya uvAca । “tato brahmAdayo devAH sarvve te SaNkarAntikam । gatvA haraM saMmumuhuH sAMsAryyA yogamAyayA ॥ SanEScaro'pi BUteSamAsAdyAntarhitastadA । vAzpavfzwiM durADarzAmavajagrAha mAyayA ॥ yadA sa nASakadvAzpAn sanDArayitumarkajaH । tadA mahAgirO kziptA vAzpAste jalaDArake ॥ lokAlokasya nikawe jalaDArAhvayo giriH । puzkaradvIpapfzWasTastoyasAgarapaScime ॥ sa tu sarvvapramARena meruparvvatasanniBaH । tasmin vinyastavAn zAzpAn na DarttuM kzama ISituH ॥ vidIrRastEstu vAzpOGErBagnamaDyo'Bavaddrutam । te vAzpAH parvvataM BittvA viviSustoyasAgaram ॥ sAgaro'pi grahItu tAnna SaSAka KarAnati । tatastu sAgaraM maDye BittvA vAzpAH samAgatAH ॥ toyaDeH prAgBavAM velAM sparSamAtrAdbiBeda tAm । viBidya velAM te vAspAH puzkaradvIpamaDyagAH ॥ nadI vEtaraRI BUtvA pUrvvasAgaragABavan । jalaDArasya vegena saMsargAt sAgarasya ca ॥ avApya sOmyatAM kiYcidvAzpAste nABidan kzitim । tvadvAzpavyAkulA pfTvI vidIrRA syAnna cecCaniH ॥ avajagrAha te vAspaM so'pi kfzRo'BavadDaWAt । SanEScareRa te voQamasamarTena lotakEH ॥ kziptErvi dAritaH so'sO jalaDAro mahAgiriH । viBidya parvvataM SamBorvvAspAste sAgaraM yayuH ॥ vEvasvatapuradbAre yojanadvayavistftA । adyApi tizWatyapagA haralotakasamBavA ॥ BittvA velAM tataH pfTvIM viBidyASu taraNgiRIm । cakrurvEtaraRInAmnA pUrvvasAgaragAminIm ॥ nAnAyAnavimAnena na drORyA syandanena ca । tarttuM SakyA sA tu nadI taptatoyA viBIzaRA ॥ duHKena tAM tu pfTivI biBartti mahatADunA । sadA cordDvagatErvAzpErvikzipanti naBaScarAn ॥ tasyA upari no yAnti devA api BayAdDara । yamadDAraM samAvftya yojanadvayavistftA । nimnaM vahati saMpUrRA BIzayantI jagattrayam ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 18 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ AsannamftyukAle vEtaraRIgavIdAnaM yaTA, -- “AsannamftyunA deyA gOH savatsA ca pUrvvavat । tadaBAve ca gOrekA narakodDAraRAya vE ॥ tadA yadi na Saknoti dAtuM vEtaraRIYca gAm । Sakto'nyo'ruk tadA dattvA Sreyo dadyAnmftasya ca ॥” pUrvvavadDemaSfNgAdinA । atra mftasya ceti SravaRAdekAdaSAhe'pi vEtaraRIdAnAcAraH । iti SudDitattvam ॥ * ॥ vEtaraRIgodAnAnantaraM prArTanAmantro yaTA, -- “yamadvAre mahAGore taptA vEtaraRI nadI । tAYca tarttuM dadAmyenAM kfzRAM vEtaraRIYca gAm ॥” iti tatprayogaH ॥ anyat mumUrzuSabde drazwavyam ॥ pitfkanyA । yaTA, -- “ayajvAnaSca yajvAnaH zitaro brahmaRaH smftAH agnisvAttA varhizado dviDA tezAM vyavasTitiH । teByaH svaDA mutAM jajYe menAM vEtaraRIM taTA ॥” iti kOrmme 13 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ (kaliNgadeSasTa-nadIviSezaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 114 । 4 । “ete kaliNgAH kOnteya ! yatra vEtaraRI nadI । yatrAyajata Darmmo'pi devAYCaraRametya vE ॥”)
m: वैतरणी (ई), f. See below.

वैतरणी f. N. of the Hindū Styx i.e. the river that flows between earth and the lower regions or abode of departed spirits presided over by Yama (it is described as rushing with great impetuosity, hot, fetid, and filled with blood, hair and bones See RTL. 290, 570), MBh.; Pur. &c.
a cow (given to Brāhmans) that transports a dead man over that river, Hcat.
N. of a sacred river in Kaliṅga or Orissa (usually called Baitaraṇī), MBh.; Hariv.; R.; Pur.
of a division of the lower regions, MW.
of the mother of the Rākṣasas, L.

k.v: सङ्घातः कालसूत्रं चेत्याद्याः सत्त्वास्तु नारकाः। प्रेता वैतरणी सिन्धुः स्यादलक्ष्मीस्तु निरृतिः॥

m: वैतरणी—दान n. N. of wk.
वैतरणी—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
वैतरणी—विधि m. N. of wk.
वैतरणी—व्रतोद्यापन-विधि m. N. of wk.
वैतरण mf(ई)n. (fr. वि-तरण) intending to cross a river, MBh.
transporting (a departed spirit) over the river that flows between earth and the lower regions (as a cow given to Brāhmans; see below and RTL. 296, 297), Hcat.
वैतरण (˚न), m. a patr. RV.
N. of a physician, Hariv.; Suśr.

m: वैतरणि f. = next, Uṇ. ii, 103, Sch.
a: वैतरणिः --णी — f. 1 N. of the river of hell. --2 N. of a river in the country of the Kaliṅgas.

s: puM, (vetasa eva । svArTe aR .) amlavetasaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ (puMsprajananam । SiSnadaRqam । iti niGaRwuH । 3 । 29 ॥ yaTA, fgvede । 10 । 95 । 4 । “divA naktaM SnaTitA vEtasena .” “vEtasena Sepo vEnasa iti puMsprajananasyeti niruktam । 3 । 21 । puMsprajananena SnaTitA tAqitA Bavati .” iti tadBAzye sAyaRaH ॥ * ॥ vetasasyAyamiti । tasyedamiti aR । vetasasambanDini, tri । yaTA, raGuH । 4 । 35 । “AtmA saMrakzitaH suhmErvf ttimASritya vEtasIm ॥”)
v: pu॰ vetasa eva svArTe aR । amlavetase jawA॰ ।
m: वैतस mf(ई)n. (fr. वेतस) made of or peculiar to a reed (˚सी वृत्ति, ‘reed-like action’ i.e. yielding to superior force, adapting one's self to circumstances), TS.; Br.; KātyŚr. &c.
वैतस m. or n. a basket made of reed, KātyŚr.
वैतस m. (met.) the penis, AV.
Rumex Vesicarius, L.
Calamus Fasciculatus, W.
a: वैतस — a. (सी f.) 1 Pertaining to a cane. --2 Reed-like, i. e. yielding to a superior foe, bowing down to a stronger enemy; आत्मा संरक्षितः सुह्नैर्वृत्तिमाश्रित्य वैतसीं R. 4. 35; Pt. 3. 19.

m: वैतसक mfn. (fr. वेतसकीय) g. बिल्वकादि.
वैतसेन m. (prob. derived fr. a misunderstanding of वैतसेन instr. RV. x, 95, 4; cf. वैतस), N. of Purū-ravas, BhP.
वैतस्त mfn. coming from or contained in the Vi-tastā (q.v.), Rājat.
वैतस्तिक mfn. (fr. वि-तस्ति) a span long (an arrow), MBh.; Hariv.; R.
वैतस्त्य mfn. id., Vcar.
वैतत्य n. (fr. वि-तत) great extension, Śukas.
